comment: He is such a passionate and knowledgable professor. I loved his lectures and the real-world applications of them. He made class very conversational yet still pushed us to understand language in a new way. Classwork was a breeze, presentations very low pressure, and informal discussion posts. Also, he brought his adorable dog to class most weeks!

Anyone who's interested in learning a language or learning about languages MUST take Dr. Soloway's SDLC class. It's a really cool class and is so helpful for this. Not too much work outside of class and a great half-credit to take. Plus he brings his dog.

Dr. Marsh is super kind and is always willing to work with you. He accepts drafts for each paper and revisions for most of them. I would definitely recommend him if you struggle with writing because he is guaranteed to help you through it.

Dr. Marsh-Soloway is amazing! He truly cares about the students and does his best to keep everyone engaged and enjoying the classes. He uses different materials, from movies to recent news, as well as varied grading methods, from participation to creative projects.

Dr. Marsh-Soloway is genuinely one of the nicest human beings I've met on this campus. He is so understanding with his deadlines and grades, he makes every effort to get people interested in class, and he doesn't try to overwhelm you with work. Dr. Marsh-Soloway is a must-take professor if you can find a class he teaches.
He is always there trying to help. It is clear that he tries hard to succeed students as much as he can instead of assessing them harshly.

Professor Soloway is not only a great teacher and instructor, but is also a great person. Despite the changes made to class structure, he was always vocal on what he expected from his students and was flexible if need be. Always willing to go the extra mile for his students both in and outside the classroom. Highly recommend, youll learn a lot!
Dr. Marsh-Soloway's class is never boring and he cares his students a lot. He grades fairly and accepts drafts for each paper. Would definitely take him again if he opens other classes.
